# Ease

How a [CameraTrack](CameraTrack.md) leg paces the run between its start and
its end.

## Values

- `linear`: Constant rate for the whole leg.
- `in`: Starts at rest and reaches full rate at the end.
- `out`: Starts at full rate and comes to rest at the end.
- `in_out`: Starts and ends at rest.
